cohort: 32 pregnant women with placenta previa percreta undergoing elective cesarean hysterectomy in each arm of the trial (64 in total).
finding: The bladder filling technique played a significant role in preventing bladder injury in women with placenta previa percreta undergoing elective cesarean hysterectomy and was associated with lower blood loss, reduced need for blood transfusion, and shorter hospital stay compared to the non-filling group.
